scholarships.name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Education, Government of India
scholarships.description: Provides financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies in colleges and universities.

scholarships.name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.description: Supports meritorious undergraduate students across all disciplines with comprehensive grant and mentorship support through their degree programs.

scholarships.name: Adobe India Women-in-Technology Scholarship
scholarships.description: Recognizes outstanding female students pursuing degrees in Computer Science, AI, and related Engineering disciplines, aiming to close the gender gap in tech leadership.

scholarships.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
scholarships.provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.description: Empowers young women to pursue technical diploma and degree education by providing annual tuition and sustenance grants.

scholarships.name: ONGC Merit Scholarship for SC/ST and OBC Students
scholarships.description: Provides substantial financial support to disadvantaged students enrolled in Engineering, Medical (MBBS), and Masters in Geophysics/Geology or MBA programs.

scholarships.name: Telangana ePASS Post-Matric Overseas & State Scholarship
scholarships.description: Comprehensive fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance for SC, ST, BC, and EBC students studying in colleges across Telangana.

scholarships.name: Tata Trust Medical and Healthcare Professional Grant
scholarships.description: Supports undergraduate and postgraduate students enrolled in recognized medical, nursing, and dental institutions in India.

scholarships.name: Kotak Kanya Scholarship for Girl Students
scholarships.description: Assists talented girls from low-income families in completing professional graduation courses including engineering, architecture, design, and medicine.

scholarships.name: Sitaram Jindal Foundation Educational Scholarship
scholarships.description: Financial scholarship for needy meritorious students pursuing Diploma, Degree, Technical, and Postgraduate programs.

scholarships.name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Minorities
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Govt of India
scholarships.description: Scholarship scheme encouraging students belonging to minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) to continue higher education.
